name: wood-crate
prompt: Make a 1 m wooden crate (a cube) and give it a procedural wood texture: brown tones with visible grain.

name: brick-wall
prompt: Make a wall 4 m wide, 2.5 m tall and 0.2 m thick, with a red brick texture and grey mortar lines. Use the brick pattern node of the texture catalog.

name: marble-tile
prompt: Make a floor tile 2 m by 2 m and 0.05 m thick with a white marble look: grey veins and a glossy surface (give it a roughness texture channel too).

name: rusty-barrel
prompt: Make a barrel: a cylinder 0.6 m across and 0.9 m tall, with a rusty metal texture. Fill the albedo, metallic and height channels (height makes the surface pitted).

name: seamless-stone
prompt: Make a sphere of radius 0.5 m that looks like speckled granite. Use a 3D (object-space) texture, the tex3d_ nodes, so the pattern has no seam anywhere.

name: mossy-block
prompt: Make a stone block 1 m by 0.5 m by 0.5 m, grey and bumpy (use the height channel for bumps), with green patches of moss (the albedo shows grey stone with green patches).
